# Zillow

> Zillow is a leading real estate platform offering home search, rental listings, mortgage services, and agent marketing tools powered by comprehensive property data and APIs.

Zillow operates a comprehensive real estate ecosystem including its core marketplace, Premier Agent platform for agent lead generation, and APIs for mortgage rate data. The platform serves homebuyers, renters, agents, and lenders with integrated tools for property discovery, valuation, and transactions.

## Key Topics

- Real Estate Marketplace
- Premier Agent Platform
- Lead Generation
- Mortgage Rates API
- Home Search
- Property Values
- Rental Listings
- Agent Marketing
- Buyer Connections
- Mortgage Loans
- Zillow Group
- Apartment Rentals
- Property Browse
- Agent Tools
- Real Estate Data

## Core Platform

- [Zillow: Real Estate, Apartments, Mortgages & Home Values](https://www.zillow.com/): Zillow's main real estate marketplace for searching homes, rentals, mortgages and property values

## Agent Platform & Tools

- [Zillow Premier Agent](https://premieragent.zillow.com/): Zillow Premier Agent platform connects agents with buyers via lead generation and marketing tools
- [Premier Agent App](https://premieragent.zillow.com/crm/video-walkthrough): Video walkthrough guide demonstrating Premier Agent app features for real estate agents

## API Reference

- [getCurrentRates](https://mortgageapi.zillow.com/api/getCurrentRates): API endpoint for querying current mortgage rates via Zillow's mortgage API
